note: Reviewed SRD 5.2 patches. The advancement module adds a new file. The weapon-mastery patch makes mastery a CHOSEN weapon kind (SRD 5.2 Weapon Mastery) instead of a property of the weapon, so a fighter who chose nothing earns nothing; it also threads the choice from the derived sheet through the party spec into the combatant. solo.2 adds two magic-item seams in build_spec.py: _item_always_on_changes projects a worn/attuned item's transfer passive_effects into the sheet's passive changes, and _check_attunement_constraint enforces the printed 'Requires Attunement by ...' line instead of ignoring it. 0.8.0: CharacterBuildSpec refuses a rules_edition the corpus does not publish (only 5.2); a cast of a spell absent from the loaded corpus now emits CastFailed(reason=unknown_spell) instead of logging only, so the player learns why the turn produced nothing. 0.9.0: starting_equipment.py resolves a background's printed starting equipment from Foundry link keys into corpus item slugs; an ambiguous truncated key is refused rather than guessed. solo.7 adds activities/damage.py: a damage-kind activity whose part is typed `healing` (SRD 5.2 Revivify's "returns with 1 Hit Point") restores Hit Points through HealingApplied instead of reaching apply_damage as an invalid damage type and being dropped. solo.8 (r177): five class-mechanic holes closed. Bardic Inspiration's die is now drawn by a SPELL attack (intent flag) and by the holder's own failed saving throw (per-holder sidecar, auto on failure), not only by a weapon attack. Jack of All Trades reaches the in-combat D20-test projection (Combatant.jack_of_all_trades -> actor_stats.check_modifier, half the Proficiency Bonus on a check that does not already add it). Rage refuses activation in heavy armor (cast_failed/heavy_armor), refuses a spell cast while raging (cast_failed/raging) and drops concentration when it lands. Relentless Rage fires on the fall to 0 Hit Points (_emit_apply_damage): CON save DC 10+5 per use, success sets Hit Points to twice the Barbarian level. Turn Undead's Turned effect now drives the creature away from the cleric on its turn (_is_turned + monster flee stance) and expires by its printed minute (10 rounds). solo.10 (r199): a monster's own effect definitions are readable at last. Monster.passive_effects restores the actor-level effects[] array the canonical cut dropped, so an activity's effects[].id ref no longer dangles; the monster attack/cast/legendary/opportunity resolution now hands those definitions to the activity context instead of an empty list. PassiveEffect.escape_dc carries SRD's printed '(escape DC N)' and travels to the victim's ActiveCondition through ActiveEffect.flags, so escape_grapple has a stored DC to roll against. rank_monster_actions gains a control tier (an action whose typed rider lands a condition the target lacks outranks Multiattack; the tier is absent for every monster whose data types no rider, so their selection is unchanged), and a sibling 'Escape Check' activity is no longer resolved on the monster's turn - it is the victim's own action. Grapple with target_id equal to the actor is now refused with target_invalid. solo.11 (r200): three slugs the player saw in English now have Russian wording. FAILURE_REASONS gains heavy_armor (a barbarian in heavy armor cannot start a Rage) and raging (a live Rage forbids casting a spell), the two refusals orchestrator._rage_armor_failure/_raging_cast_failure already emit; GAME_TERMS gains drop_prone, the intent_type r197 emits for the self-prone action. No host-side dictionary was added. solo.12 (r203): ending a grapple clears every condition its effect installed, not only Grappled. A typed monster grapple carries its printed riders in one statuses list (Behir Constrict: Grappled (escape DC 16) + Restrained until the grapple ends; Shambling Mound Engulf adds Blinded), and those riders expire for no other reason than "until the grapple ends". _release_grapple_conditions reads live.conditions_by_effect and emits one ConditionRemoved per rider after the effect leaves active_effects (the stacking guard needs that order); both release paths (a successful escape_grapple and the grappler becoming Incapacitated) use it. Measured r203: a successful escape used to leave the victim Blinded and Restrained for the rest of the fight. solo.13 (r204): a monster command is priced by the stat-block action's own typed activation. A Bonus Action activity (the pirate captain's Captain's Charm, the elephant's Trample) used to spend action_available, leave bonus_action_available True and block the Action the monster still had; _classify_action_cost now reads activation.type through _stat_block_action_is_bonus, _consume_intent_budget pays the Bonus Action, and a second bonus command is refused with no_action_economy on the attack surface. A commanded save action that places a template (a breath weapon cone, a fear aura radius) is now gated by its own geometry: _stat_block_target_out_of_range reads _monster_area + area_cells from the monster's cell, so a named target 60 ft away is refused out_of_range instead of taking the breath, and _area_plan lets such a command area-expand like the same action on the monster's own turn.
